LESSON: CARE FOR THE TEETH PRACTICES

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.3: Care for the teeth PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Care for the teeth PRACTICES. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. name items used to clean their teeth,
2. talk about items used to clean their teeth
3. clean teeth appropriately for personal hygiene teeth teeth?
4. tell appropriate times for cleaning the teeth for cleaning their teeth cleaning of teeth related to care for the teeth Core-Competence to be developed:

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
2. Explain Care for the teeth PRACTICES to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
4. Show that you can: name items used to clean their teeth,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Care for the teeth PRACTICES. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Care for the teeth PRACTICES important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
